sloka: अभिनिष्कम्य तद्द्वारं बलाध्यक्षमुवाच ह ।त्वरयस्व बलं तूर्णं किं चिरेण युयुत्सतः ।। ६.५१.२१ ।।।।
transliteration: abhiniṣkamya taddvāraṁ balādhyakṣamuvāca ha ।tvarayasva balaṁ tūrṇaṁ kiṁ cireṇa yuyutsataḥ ।। 6.51.21 ।।।।

translations.english: Commanded by the Intelligent king of Rakshasas in that manner, Dhumraksha offered prayers and went from there joyfully.
translations.hindi: इस प्रकार विलाप करते हुए बिभीषण को गले लगा, बल- वान्‌ सुग्रीव ने यह कहा
